name: resume_interrupted_task
goal: Resume an interrupted task from partial state without redoing completed work
description: A previous session worked in this workspace and was interrupted mid-task. Recover the state, finish the job, and prove it.
preconditions: a prior session worked here and was interrupted
the workspace may contain partially completed work
procedure: Inspect the workspace for partially completed work (new/modified files vs git status)
Read any leftover test or verification output
Determine the last completed step from evidence
Continue from the next step — never from scratch
Re-run the verification plan to prove completion
verification: The project's verification plan passes (tests/build green); COMPLETED only on proof

examples.goal: Your previous response was interrupted. Continue where you left off
